usage: codex_jobs.py run [-h] --name NAME [--model MODEL] [--effort EFFORT]
                         [--sandbox {read-only,workspace-write,danger-full-access}]
                         [--cwd CWD] [--add-dir ADD_DIR] [--network]
                         [--mcp-profile {minimal,browser,full}] --prompt-file
                         PROMPT_FILE [--task-type TASK_TYPE]
                         [--notes-hint NOTES_HINT] [--launch-key LAUNCH_KEY]
                         [--original-product-retry-key ORIGINAL_PRODUCT_RETRY_KEY]
                         [--resume-session RESUME_SESSION]
                         [--parent-job-id PARENT_JOB_ID]
                         [--review-source-jobs IDS]
                         [--review-excluded-models MODELS]
                         [--model-recovery-from MODEL]
                         [--effort-origin {policy,owner_request}]
                         [--model-origin {policy,owner_request}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --name NAME
  --model MODEL         default: Opus for review, Sol for other tasks;
                        explicit model choices win
  --effort EFFORT       default: max; managed AI hints follow owner policy
  --sandbox {read-only,workspace-write,danger-full-access}
  --cwd CWD
  --add-dir ADD_DIR
  --network             allow network (workspace-write only)
  --mcp-profile {minimal,browser,full}
                        minimal disables four stdio MCP servers; browser keeps
                        node_repl; full keeps all
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --task-type TASK_TYPE
  --notes-hint NOTES_HINT
  --launch-key LAUNCH_KEY
                        idempotent launch identifier (32 lowercase hex
                        characters)
  --resume-session RESUME_SESSION
                        continue a recorded Codex session UUID instead of
                        starting a new one
  --original-product-retry-key ORIGINAL_PRODUCT_RETRY_KEY
                        reserved retry key for original ToDo 1626 only (32
                        lowercase hex); requires the same --launch-key and
                        waits for product-retry-bind before execution
  --parent-job-id PARENT_JOB_ID
                        running parent job (otherwise inherited from CC_JOB_ID)
  --review-source-jobs IDS
                        comma-separated durable source jobs, including exited writers
  --review-excluded-models MODELS
                        comma-separated routing exclusions; not proof of authorship
  --model-recovery-from MODEL
                        one-launch routing hint after a managed model failure
  --effort-origin {policy,owner_request}
                        policy hint or recorded individual owner effort override
  --model-origin {policy,owner_request}
                        policy hint or recorded individual owner model override
